contributions.title: Contributions Received
contributions.intro: Amounts received by the Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund through online channels and through handovers to the Hon. Finance Minister.
contributions.register: Register of contributions handed over to the Hon. Finance Minister
contributions.registerNote: A name-wise record of contributions received by cheque, cash, voucher or online payment, verified by the Fund Section.
contributions.accountStatusNote: This is the fund's account position; it is not added to the total contributions received.
contributions.settlementNote: The difference between the NPR recorded by this portal ({receipts}) and the NPR already deposited in the fund’s accounts since the flood ({deposited}) is {gap}, which is settlement and cheque clearing still in progress; it is reconciled by the Fund Section.
contributions.nrbTitle: Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund — account status by bank
contributions.nrbSubtitle: The position of the fund's own bank accounts
contributions.nrbNote: The balance held before the flood is not counted as a contribution. Of the amount deposited since, NPR 1 billion has been transferred to the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority.
contributions.handoverSubline: {entries} entries · {donors} contributors · USD cheques listed under foreign assistance
contributions.registerShort: Handed over to the Hon. Finance Minister
contributions.registerGap: Entries numbered {from} to {to} will be added once the Fund Section supplies them.

foreign.title: Foreign Assistance
foreign.intro: Every amount received in foreign currency after the flood — including USD cheques handed over to the Hon. Finance Minister — is counted in this section.
foreign.subsetNote: Identified contributors are part of the total deposited in the fund's USD accounts; their amounts are not added on top of it.
foreign.kpiTotalSub: Deposited in the fund's USD accounts after the flood
foreign.dailyUsdTitle: Daily deposits into the USD accounts
foreign.dailyUsdNote: USD 11,713,952 was deposited on Bhadra 19, the day NVIDIA's USD 10 million arrived.
foreign.donateSub: The official payment portal — card, QR, IPS and remittance, from Nepal and abroad
foreign.kpiReportedSub: pledges, cash, goods and teams — listed, not added to the total
foreign.kpiReportedFoot: {count} governments, agencies and companies · {withUsd} with a dollar figure
foreign.kpiRegisterSub: by name, in the Fund's own records
foreign.registerNoteMerged: Rows whose source is "Ministry of Finance" are contributions verified in the Fund's own records and are counted above. Rows whose source is "Prime Minister's Office" come from the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers' rescue portal (rescue.opmcm.gov.np/donations) — pledges, cash through partners, relief goods and teams; they are not verified in the Fund's records and are not added to any total. Amounts in other currencies carry the Office's own dollar conversion.
foreign.byTypeNote: Verified deposits and the Prime Minister's Office's figures together, by contributor type; only the verified part is counted in the total.

plans.title: Government Action Plans
plans.intro: Reform and revival action plans announced by the Ministry of Finance under the Hon. Finance Minister, Dr. Swarnim Wagle, action by action: who is responsible for each, and by when. Figures and wording follow the published document.
plans.roadmapSub: A time axis from the day the plan was issued to its last deadline. Each mark is a deadline the plan sets, with the number of actions due by it and their numbers beneath; select a mark to read only those actions.
plans.byAgencyNote: An action shared by two bodies counts once for each.
plans.listSub: Every action as the plan words it, with its responsible body and deadline.
plans.unstatedAgency: Where the plan names no body, the issuing ministry is shown.

disburse.title: Fund usage and disbursement
disburse.sub: Money out of the Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund, and how the receiving agency has passed it on — beside what the Fund has collected.
disburse.kpiOnwardSub: by the receiving agency, as it reports
disburse.stepOnward: Disbursed to districts and local governments
disburse.stepHeld: With NDRRMA, not yet reported disbursed
disburse.tableSub: Each entry as its source document records it. Later transfers and disbursements are added here as they are published.
disburse.note: The transfers out of the Fund are what the Fund's own statement records as fund usage. The onward figures are what the receiving agency itself has published; they will be updated as it reports further disbursement. Nothing here is netted against contributions.

announced.title: Announced domestic support
announced.sub: As listed by the Prime Minister's Office — listed, not added to the total
announced.kpiPledgedSub: pledges with a rupee figure, summed — not added to the total
announced.note: These entries are taken word for word from the domestic support list on the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers' rescue portal. A contribution is counted only once the Fund's own records carry it, so nothing here is added to the total above. Nepali Congress's NPR 10 million is already counted in the handover register (no. 336), and the cash to districts is money out of the Fund, shown under fund usage.

customs.title: Customs revenue — target and collection
